selectionHeading: Bring the specification back to your project.
selectionSensorText: Device models, radio protocol, country, device count and reporting profile.
selectionInstallText: Gateway position, antenna, power, environmental conditions and mounting.
selectionSystemText: Backhaul, MQTT endpoint, data mapping, alert recipients and acceptance test.
integrationIntro: Connect field measurements to Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform. Keep sensor compatibility, gateway forwarding and platform services defined in the same integration plan.
cloudText: View uploaded monitoring data online and receive alerts when measurements exceed configured thresholds. Configure the monitoring points, limits and notification recipients around the site's operating procedures.
cloudBullet1: Online access to uploaded monitoring data
cloudBullet2: Configured threshold alarms and notification workflow
cloudBullet3: Agreed sampling, reporting and response requirements
customerText: Agree the MQTT connection and payload mapping with the receiving system. Define device identity, measurement units and timestamps so records can be interpreted consistently.
handoverText: Verify a known sensor reading at the receiving platform, then test a configured threshold event and its notification recipient. Record the actual radio and backhaul conditions as part of the handover.
faqIntro: Practical answers for gateway selection, radio planning, installation and platform integration.
